subject: Quick dinner invite?
text: Hi, I know we keep saying we'll catch up properly, so I'm putting some pressure on myself and inviting you out this Thursday. My treat, within reason, because something unexpected came up with the office catering budget and I don't want my own weird guilt spirals to become your problem. I thought we could try the little vegetarian place near the station; they have good flatbreads and a quiet corner, which sounds perfect after a day of meetings. I can finish work a little early if needed, and I'll bring the new book you mentioned so we can argue about the ending over soup. If Thursday is bad, Friday evening works too, or even a late lunch on Saturday if you're busy sleeping in. I really just want a relaxed conversation without laptops or deadlines for once. Let me know if either day suits you, and feel free to suggest somewhere else if you're craving something else, since the main point is spending time together rather than getting a specific table. I'm looking forward to seeing you and hearing about your trip planning, and thanks again for checking in last week when I was swamped.
